name: Oh My OpenCode (OmO)
tagline: Multi-agent distribution for OpenCode, Codex and its own standalone runtime.
description: Extends OpenCode with a multi-agent stack: an orchestrator delegates to specialist agents for exploration, planning, implementation and review, with per-task model routing and background tasks. The project also ships a Codex plugin (LazyCodex) and OmO Native, a standalone build on the senpi fork of pi.

pricing.notes: The distribution is free to install and use your own model access; it is source-available under the Sustainable Use License.
